facts.text: Business Central automatically buffers inserts to send them to SQL Server at one time, reducing server calls and improving performance.
Bulk inserts improve scalability by delaying actual insert until last moment, reducing table lock time especially for SIFT indexes.
Records are sent to SQL Server when COMMIT is called, MODIFY or DELETE is called, or FIND or CALC methods are called.
Bulk inserts are not used if code uses return value from INSERT call or if table contains BLOB fields or AutoIncrement properties.
Disable bulk inserts by setting BufferedInsertEnabled parameter to FALSE in CustomSettings.config file for troubleshooting.
